gloss_hint: This means second-guessing every decision after it is made, asking others for reassurance before acting, and losing confidence in one's own reading of situations.
This means smiling through dissatisfaction, answering "fine" when asked how things are, and keeping grievances so well hidden that few around notice the resentment underneath.
This means going under at the first heavy load, feeling swamped by ordinary demands, and saying one cannot manage when others expect a steady hand.
This means losing the thread of conversations, starting tasks without finishing them, and misplacing things, with thoughts jumping sideways before any point is made.
